description: This is the Pinion Gear that transmits rotation to the steering rack, providing mechanical advantage and directional control to the wheels.
This is the Steering Column that mounts and supports the steering shaft, providing structural support and rotation to the steering system.
This is the Steering Wheel that provides the interface for the driver to input rotation, controlling the steering system and vehicle direction.
This is the Tie Rod that connects the steering rack to the wheel hub, providing a mechanical link and transferring rotation to the wheels for directional control.
